meteoritical-society.landings.name: Meteorite Landings
meteoritical-society.landings.summary: Every meteorite on the Meteoritical Society's list with a recorded location — some 32,000 — with its classification, mass, year, and whether its fall was seen or it was found later. NASA's copy of the list, converted to GeoJSON for Platmark.
meteoritical-society.landings.attribution: Meteorite Landings, The Meteoritical Society, via NASA's Open Data Portal

layers.name: Meteorite Falls & Finds
layers.summary: Where recognised meteorites fell or were found, named once you zoom in. Most of the dense clusters are Antarctic ice fields and deserts, where they are easiest to spot.
